approvers: Developer or main contractor (specifies protection and who pays)
reason: We don't buy this today. The developer or main contractor sets what protection we give and who pays, and my jobs are small houses and little blocks. At about 19 euro a m2 it costs far more than film and tape, and I don't want another contractor on my site.
objection: ACHV is a contractor too. I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme, and I'd be paying more than film and tape for something nobody has asked me to provide.
instead: Cheap protection film and tape, applied by my own lads, only where the package requires it.
would_change_my_mind: The main contractor or developer specifying it in the package and paying for it, with a licensed applicator who isn't a competitor.
